title: Sources: Bulls' Caleb Wilson to have surgery on fractured hand, miss 4-6 weeks
text:

 Sources: Bulls' Caleb Wilson to have surgery on fractured hand, miss 4-6 weeks 
 By Jamal Collier Thursday, November 12, 2026 10:06PM 
 Chicago Bulls rookie Caleb Wilson will have surgery on his fractured right hand and miss four to six weeks, sources told ESPN's Shams Charania.
 Wilson injured his hand during the third quarter of Wednesday's 124-119 loss to the San Antonio Spurs when he tried to knock the ball out of Victor Wembanyama 's hands. Wilson did not finish the game.
 Wilson, the No. 4 pick in the 2026 draft, had been one of the bright spots for the Bulls during a 1-9 start. The 20-year-old rookie was averaging 18.9 points, 6.2 rebounds and 1.9 assists on 42% shooting in his first 10 games.
